description: Defines a sealed class 'PaymentMethod' with subclasses for different payment options (Card, CashOnDelivery, OnlineWallet), including utility functions to list supported methods and decode from an ID.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Sealed class representing different payment methods. Includes subclasses for card, cash on delivery, and online wallet, along with companion object functions for supported methods and ID decoding.

classes.name: PaymentMethod.Card
classes.description: Data class for credit/debit card payments, with default ID and display name.

classes.name: PaymentMethod.CashOnDelivery
classes.description: Data class for cash on delivery payment, with default ID and display name.

classes.name: PaymentMethod.OnlineWallet
classes.description: Data class for online wallet payment, with default ID and display name.

methods.name: PaymentMethod.supported
methods.description: Returns a list of supported payment methods for UI purposes, in a stable order.

methods.name: PaymentMethod.fromId
methods.description: Decodes a string ID into the corresponding PaymentMethod instance, or null if unrecognized.
